title: Theory of Mind in TPJ-M (Saxe & Kanwisher 2003)

source.title: Understanding other minds: linking developmental psychology and functional neuroimaging
source.version_note: NeuroImage 19(4):1835-1842. TPJ-M theory of mind attribution.

passage: Temporoparietal junction (TPJ-M) is specialized for attributing mental states to others (theory of mind). Functional localization supports distinct other-mind attribution mechanism.
context: Neuroscience domain: other-mind attribution and TPJ-M. Relevant to AI repository's attribution of external query intent vs internal self-model.
source_note: Verified via DOI; TPJ-M localization and theory of mind confirmed.
literary_invitation: Does the repository distinguish between external query intent (other-mind) and internal prediction (self)? Where is the boundary in the memory database?
scope_note: Q-003: conditional hypothesis on other-mind attribution (HYP-20261117-b17a54). Excludes phenomenal consciousness claims.

verification.note: Confirmed TPJ-M/other-mind; excluded phenomenal consciousness attribution.
